svg.title: Bookkeeping architecture
svg.desc: The hexagon of the bookkeeping bounded context: the console adapter drives the application through the FinancialTransactionRegistering inbound port, the handler registers a Transaction, and the event store and logged notices adapters implement the Transactions and RegistrationNotices outbound ports over PostgreSQL and the console log. Outside the application, Kafka Connect publishes each insert of the event store as TransactionRegistered to Kafka, which streams it to the account context.
